svg.title: Only three roles clear Customs; merge roles get V10 at most
svg.desc: Sixteen checks V1 to V16 against six roles. Builder, reviewer and onboarder columns run through clearCustoms in production. Resolver, merge-fix and resolution-review columns are declared but no production path runs them; the resolver alone gets V10, run by hand by the Airlock through MergeRun.resolutionIsSound, and a refusal there refuses the merge. V3, V4 and V15 for a builder and V4 for a reviewer resume the same session.
